evals.expected_output: Runs the full handoff ritual in a clean Git project, records an honest retrospective, updates forward-looking handoff state, and reports every side effect truthfully.
expectations: Selects full mode because the user message is exactly qqq
Runs project-declaration.mjs first and uses declared help_dir / incident_archive / sessions_dir / handoff / backlog / finish_script paths, falling back to defaults for missing keys
Includes at least one concrete weakness and routes each reusable lesson
Session section contains the two fixed lines: 帮助/FAQ: 有 <文件路径>（<编号>） or 帮助/FAQ: 无（<一句理由>）, and qqq 版本: X.Y.Z (with the 落后 form when version-check reports stale), then runs validate-session.mjs
Stages only qqq-owned paths and checks active no-push instructions before push
Final report restates the 帮助/FAQ and qqq 版本 lines verbatim and includes the receipt line commit ✓ <sha> | ✗（原因） / push ✓ | ✗（原因） / 开窗 ✓ | ✗（原因）
Reports archive, handoff, commit, push, and window-open results separately; says 本次未开新窗 explicitly if the window was not opened

evals.prompt: 帮我整理一下下个对话应该说什么，先别提交也别开新窗口。
evals.expected_output: Creates or proposes handoff artifacts without committing, pushing, or opening a new window.
expectations: Selects handoff mode
Does not commit, push, or open a new window
Produces a prompt containing 先读, 当前状态, and 下一步
Includes a 模型 suggestion line with /model and /effort chosen from the next-window topic
Session section still carries the two fixed lines 帮助/FAQ: 有/无（…） and qqq 版本: X.Y.Z, validated by validate-session.mjs
Receipt line reports commit ✗ / push ✗ / 开窗 ✗ each with the reason handoff mode
Does not copy completed-history details into HANDOFF

evals.prompt: /qqq:qqq preview 先让我看看会改哪些文件
evals.expected_output: Performs a read-only preview with proposed session, HANDOFF, and next-window prompt content.
expectations: Selects preview mode
Does not write files or mutate Git
Lists the exact files it would change
Shows the proposed session section including the two fixed 帮助/FAQ and qqq 版本 lines, but does not run validate-session.mjs
Shows the proposed next-window prompt

evals.prompt: 跑完整 qqq，但我前面说过今天绝对不要 push。
evals.expected_output: Completes local handoff work while preserving the active no-push instruction.
expectations: Treats the active no-push instruction as overriding full mode
May create a local commit but does not push
States clearly that push was withheld
Does not weaken or reinterpret the user's no-push instruction

evals.prompt: 这个目录不是 Git 仓库，不过还是帮我 qqq，交接给下个窗口。
evals.expected_output: Completes the non-Git parts of the handoff and reports Git steps as skipped.
expectations: Does not treat missing Git metadata as fatal
Creates or proposes session and HANDOFF artifacts
Skips commit and push honestly
Receipt line shows commit ✗（非 Git 目录） / push ✗（非 Git 目录） and an explicit 开窗 result
Still produces a validated next-window prompt

evals.prompt: qqq。注意 HANDOFF.md 是另一个窗口正在改的，别把它的内容卷进我的提交。
evals.expected_output: Preserves concurrent edits and refuses unsafe whole-file staging.
expectations: Recognizes HANDOFF.md as pre-existing concurrent work
Avoids whole-file staging when ownership cannot be separated
Does not use reset, checkout, restore, git add -A, or git commit -a
Explains what needs user confirmation before commit or push
